system.description:
You take a stance that allows you to place all of your weight behind your attack. Make a melee taijutsu attack against a target creature. On a hit, you deal your weapons damage + 4d8 and the target must make a Strength saving throw, falling Prone on a failed save.

Chain 1: A 15-foot cube originating from you becomes difficult terrain.

Chain 2: A creature that fails their saving throw, becomes Bruised.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d8.
